mapper.select: SELECT id, simulation_result_id, assignee_id, title, description, severity, status, created_at FROM risks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risks (assignee_id, title, description, severity, status) VALUES (#{assigneeId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{severity}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE risks SET assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, severity = #{severity}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
